{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Belt}}
[[File:AsteroidField-TPOV.jpg|250px|thumb|A [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] navigating an asteroid field]]
{{Quote|Sir, the possibility of successfully navigating an asteroid field is approximately three thousand, seven hundred and twenty to one!''"<br /> "''Never tell me the odds.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|audio=3720to1-TheOdds.flac|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
There were many '''asteroid fields''', '''belts''' and '''clusters''' in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Because of the erratic movements of various asteroids within the area, traveling through them was very dangerous (with a rough estimate calculation once stating that successful travel through one had the approximate odds of 3,720 to 1), often resulting in the destruction of various ships. It was therefore considered inadvisable to do so unless the pilot was extremely desperate.<ref name="ESB" />
